nodes.summary: There is a real number $c > 0$ such that for every simple graph $G$ on a finite vertex set with chromatic number $m$ there are a subgraph $H$ of $G$ and a natural number $k$ with $k \ge c\,m / \log m$ such that the cochromatic number of $H$ is at least $k$. Moreover, there is a real number $c > 0$ with the same property for the bound $k \ge c\sqrt{m / \log m}$.
nodes.title: Alon–Krivelevich–Sudakov theorem on subgraphs of large cochromatic number

nodes.summary: The proposition asserts two statements. First, there is a real number $c > 0$ such that for every simple graph $G$ on a finite vertex set with chromatic number $m$ there are a subgraph $H$ of $G$ and a natural number $k$ with $k \ge c\,m / \log m$ such that the cochromatic number of $H$ is at least $k$. Second, there is a real number $c > 0$ with the same property for the bound $k \ge c\sqrt{m / \log m}$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 760: subgraphs of large cochromatic number
